title: FOMC communications blackout begins (through 2027-04-29)
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/fomc-blackout-period-calendar.pdf — PDF re-downloaded (HTTP 200, 98,013 bytes) and its content streams inflated in-session 2026-09-05. It is titled '2025-2027 FOMC Trading and External Communications Blackout Calendar' (so it spans 2027) and its footnote states the policy verbatim: 'The blackout period will begin at 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time the second Saturday before a meeting and end at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time the day after a meeting. For example, if the Committee meeting starts on a Tuesday, the blackout period will begin at the start of the Saturday that falls ten days earlier, and if the meeting ends on a Wednesday, the blackout period will end at the end of Thursday.' Apr 27 2027 is a Tuesday and Apr 28 a Wednesday, so the source's own worked example gives Saturday 2027-04-17 through Thursday 2027-04-29 with no inference of ours. DECODED, NOT MERELY DERIVED: this session re-ran the vector-grid technique fomc-blackout-start-2027-01-16's initial research established — inflating the content streams, tracking the fill-colour operators (the legend grey resolving to 0.851 = 'Blackout dates'), and hit-testing every shaded rectangle against the reconstructed grid geometry (21.75pt cells on 14.4pt rows, three month-columns per band, four bands per page). Validated FIRST on the PDF's 2026 page, where it returns Sep 5-17 / Oct 17-29 / Nov 28 -> Dec 10, matching all three sibling ledgers exactly; the 2027 page then returns all eight windows — Jan 16-28, Mar 6-18, APR 17-29, May 29 -> Jun 10, Jul 17-29, Sep 4-16, Oct 16-28, Nov 27 -> Dec 9 — of which the first two match the two 2027 blackout entries already in this calendar TO THE DAY, and all eight are internally consistent with the 2027 meeting dates read off a different surface of the same document family (fomccalendars.htm). So these are the Board's own highlighted days, not our arithmetic. Filed estimate rather than confirmed because it is a firm rule applied to a TENTATIVE meeting date: fomccalendars.htm states every 2027 date is 'tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it', so the promotion trigger is the 2027-03-16/17 meeting, not a better fetch — and decoding shading raises provenance, not certainty, since the Board shaded those days because it PLANS to meet Apr 27-28. Discovered during the fomc-2027-04-28 initial research, checked 2026-09-05
notes: The gate around the April 2027 FOMC (fomc-2027-04-28, estimate), and what makes it worth a slot rather than a duplicate of the decision entry is WHERE IT CLOSES. It ends at the end of Thursday 2027-04-29, so the first session in which any Fed official may speak is Friday 2027-04-30 — and that single session is the most loaded one in this event's corridor, for three independent reasons the fomc-2027-04-28 research establishes. (1) The Bank of Japan's April 2027 MPM is the SAME TWO DAYS (boj-decision-2027-04-28, estimate), with the BoJ decision publishing ~midday JST Wed Apr 28 (approx. 23:00 ET Tue Apr 27) and the FOMC statement at 14:00 ET Wed Apr 28 (approx. 03:00 JST Thu Apr 29) — roughly fifteen hours apart inside one US trading day — and the ASYMMETRY is that the BoJ publishes a full Outlook projection set that day while this FOMC carries NO SEP (the 2027 asterisks sit on Mar 16-17, Jun 8-9, Sep 14-15, Dec 7-8). (2) Japan's Cabinet Office holiday file makes 2027-04-29 Showa Day, plus May 3/4/5, so Tokyo is CLOSED when the FOMC statement lands and Friday Apr 30 is Japan's only open session — carrying two days of Outlook digestion and its first chance to price the Fed — before a further three-day Golden Week close. (3) BEA's own machine-readable feed puts the advance Q1 GDP estimate on the last Wed/Thu of April (2025-04-30, 2026-04-30); the last Thursday of April 2027 is Apr 29, so the quarter's first GDP estimate plausibly lands INSIDE this gate's final day and AFTER the Committee has voted — registered as FT-fomc-2027-04-28-3 rather than asserted, since both BEA surfaces stop at 2026-12-23 and bls.gov returns 403. The practical consequence recorded in that ledger: nothing in the 2027-04-30 session may be attributed to the Fed, the BoJ, the Outlook Report or the GDP print individually — three independent drivers land in one session and the window contains no way to separate them. Note also that this gate is EMPTY of tracked events apart from the two same-day decisions: the nearest entry before it is japan-food-tax-cut-2027-04-01, 27 days earlier, which makes the US April corridor unpopulated rather than quiet — the same demonstration boj-decision-2027-04-28 made when its own +/-5-day window returned zero and had missed a high-impact same-day FOMC. Estimate widens caution only; promote once the 2027-03-16/17 meeting confirms the 2027 calendar, and the date re-derives from whatever it confirms.
